title: PyUltraLight 2, SK fork (PyUL_SK)
description:
Fork of PyUltraLight 2 used for the black-hole simulations of Stone Skipping Black Holes in Ultralight Dark Matter Solitons: a pseudo-spectral (split-step Fourier) solver for the Schroedinger-Poisson equations of ultralight dark matter coupled to N-body point masses, with cell-centred grids, manual dynamical friction, isolated-potential and portability fixes, and an optional inline eigenmode (c_nlm) decomposition. Release 30.50 is a maintenance release of the 30.40 core used for part of the paper runs; see CHANGELOG.md.

Please also cite the upstream PyUltraLight and PyUltraLight 2 works listed in CITATION.cff.
